name: Chile

flag.description: Two horizontal bands of white over red, with a blue square in the upper hoist corner, as tall as the white band, holding a white five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky and the Pacific Ocean, white the snow of the Andes and red the blood shed for independence; the star is a guide to progress and honour.

hook: Chile's lone star sits in a blue square covering only the white half; Texas-style flags run the blue bar down the full height.
trivia: Chileans call their flag "La Estrella Solitaria" (the Lone Star).
Chile stretches about 4,300 km from north to south but averages only around 180 km wide.
The Atacama Desert in northern Chile is one of the driest places on Earth outside the poles.
